# m08_amgm8

Let $a, b, c$ be positive real numbers. Prove that
$$(a+b)(b+c)(c+a) \ge 8abc.$$

Prove the theorem `m08_amgm8`. This is AM–GM applied to each factor; a direct
route is the sum-of-squares identity
$(a+b)(b+c)(c+a) - 8abc = a(b-c)^2 + b(c-a)^2 + c(a-b)^2 \ge 0$.
